sources.title: Attention Residuals
sources.supports: Learned per-sublayer pseudo-query, RMS-normalized keys and raw source values; Full/Block candidate sets; completed-block plus current partial; first-sublayer exclusion of an absent partial; exact two-phase online-softmax merge.
sources.limits: Block AttnRes changes the candidates, while two-phase execution merges the same candidates exactly. The local fixed source vectors do not implement the coupled complete backbone. No author training, scaling-law, pipeline communication or GPU throughput result is reproduced.

sources.title: MoonshotAI/Attention-Residuals official README
sources.version: Text checked 2026-10-30; read-only connector receipt in official-readme-source.json
sources.supports: The repository describes its snippet as pseudocode; normalization applies to K and softmax is over the source/depth axis; block_size counts attention and MLP sublayers.
sources.limits: The snippet is explanatory, not a complete runnable training release; its initial state conventions are not guessed. The paper's explicit first-layer candidate set is used for the boundary explanation.

localScope: Four fixed 3D source vectors, 30 local finite differences, exact grouping checks, one learned-query SGD step, and explicit absent-partial/normalization counterexamples.
